Name: Community Center Bundle Tracker
Author: Solaris710
Description:
Never forget to turn an item in again! 


[size=4][b]Features:[/b][/size]

Adds a house icon to the top right of any item needed for a community center bundle that has not been turned in. Pressing in the left stick on controller or B on keyboard will display the bundle the item is needed for, as well as the quantity. The controls can be edited in the config file, as well as completely disabled.

I Highly recommend pairing this mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6893]Community Center Helper[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]

[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]

1. [url=https://smapi.io/]Download/Install SMAPI
[/url]
2. Drag and drop the unpacked folder to your mods folder.

3. Launch the game modded through SMAPI

[size=4][b]Compatibility:

[/b][/size][size=3]This mod is potentially incompatible with mods that change the community center bundles. I have not tested this with anything other than the vanilla community center, so I can't guarantee compatibility for those mods.[/size]

[size=3]This mod by default is not compatible with any mod that modifies the B keybind or the left stick press. These can be modified or disabled in the config to fix this, however.[/size]
